cms_sign_up_description: Set up the first super admin for this site.
cms_sign_up_only_once: Sign-up is only available before the first admin is created.
cms_media_help: Upload images, video, audio, or PDFs. Served from R2, metadata in D1.
cms_media_empty: No media yet. Upload your first file above.
cms_media_delete_confirm: Delete this file? The R2 object and metadata will be removed.
cms_media_folder_delete_confirm: Delete this folder? Sub-folders and assets will fall back to the root.
cms_blocks_help: Reusable snippets you can drop into article and page bodies via block shortcodes.
cms_blocks_empty: No blocks yet. Create one to surface a reusable CTA, callout, or footer in many places at once.
cookie_banner_body: We use a small number of cookies to keep the site working and (with your permission) understand how it's used.
cookie_cat_functional_help: Required for the site to work (login session, language, this consent record). Always on.
cookie_cat_analytics_help: Privacy-friendly page-view counts that help us understand which content is read.
cookie_cat_marketing_help: Third-party tracking and embedded media. Off by default.
cms_pages_help: Static pages: About, Contact, Privacy, etc. Reuses the markdown editor and SEO surface.
cms_pages_empty: No pages yet. Pages are good for permanent content like About, Contact, and Privacy.
cms_pages_slug_help: Lowercase ASCII letters, digits, hyphens. Use slashes for nesting (about/team).
cms_navigation_help: Build the site's primary header and footer menus. Items can target pages, articles, categories, tags, or custom URLs.
cms_navigation_items_empty: No items in this menu yet. Add one below.
cms_pages_seeded: Created {n} pages from templates. They start as drafts — review before publishing.
cms_dashboard_analytics_empty: No data yet. Visit a page on the public site (with analytics consent) to seed the counter.
cms_settings_cfa_token_help: Paste your CWA site token to load the third-party beacon. Only loads when the visitor consents to analytics. Leave blank to use only the first-party D1 counter.
error_404_subtitle: The link might be old, or the page may have moved. Try searching, or head back home.
error_5xx_title: Something went wrong on our side.
error_5xx_subtitle: We've been notified. Try again in a moment, or head back home while we sort it out.
cms_forms_help: Build forms (contact, lead capture, RSVP) and review submissions. Each form has a public POST endpoint.
cms_forms_empty: No forms yet. Create one to start collecting submissions.
cms_forms_fields_empty: No fields yet. Add one with the buttons above.
cms_forms_success_help: Shown after a successful submission. Falls back to a generic thank-you when blank.
cms_forms_submissions_empty: No submissions yet — share the public endpoint to start collecting.
cms_subscribers_help: Email subscribers signed up via the public newsletter form. Manage signups + send digests.
cms_subscribers_empty: No subscribers yet. Add a subscribe form to your site to start collecting.
cms_subscribers_no_provider_help: Subscribers can sign up but no confirmation emails or digests will be sent. Configure Resend in settings to enable.
cms_subscribers_send_digest_help: Picks the last 7 days of published articles per locale and emails every active subscriber.
cms_settings_newsletter_help: Newsletter is fully optional. Leave blank to skip — the public subscribe form will be disabled. Add a Resend API key + sender to enable double-opt-in confirmation + digest sending.
cms_settings_newsletter_resend_key_help: Get a free API key at resend.com/api-keys. Leave blank to disable email sending.
cms_settings_newsletter_sender_help: Format: "Your Name <hello@yourdomain.com>". The domain must be verified in Resend.
cms_settings_newsletter_allow_single: Allow single-opt-in mode when no provider is configured
cms_settings_newsletter_allow_single_hel: When checked, subscribers signing up without a provider configured are immediately marked confirmed. Off = public signup form returns 503 until a provider is wired.
cms_cover_media_help: Paste a media ID from the Media library, or leave blank.
cms_categories_help: Categories group articles into sections. Each article belongs to at most one.
cms_categories_empty: No categories yet. Create one to start organising articles.
cms_category_delete_confirm: Delete this category? Articles using it will keep a dangling reference.
cms_tags_help: Tags are free-form labels. An article can have many.
cms_tag_delete_confirm: Delete this tag? It will be removed from every article that uses it.
cms_profile_help: Your account details and password. Changes here affect only you.
cms_profile_image_help: Optional. Leave blank to fall back to your initials.
cms_profile_email_help: Ask an admin if your email address needs to change.
cms_password_help: Changing your password signs you out everywhere else.
cms_password_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
cms_password_changed: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
cms_users_help: People with access to this CMS. Only super admins and admins can change roles or remove users.
cms_users_empty: Only you so far. Invite a teammate to start collaborating.
cms_user_delete_confirm: Remove this user? Their articles stay but the account is deleted permanently.
cms_user_self_delete_blocked: You can't remove your own account.
cms_user_self_role_blocked: You can't change your own role.
cms_user_last_super_admin_blocked: At least one super admin must remain.
cms_invite_help: Generate a one-shot signup link. The first person to open it claims an account at the chosen role.
cms_invite_link_ready: Invite link ready — share it with your teammate
cms_invite_revoke_confirm: Revoke this invite link? It will stop working immediately.
cms_invite_accept_help: You've been invited to join as {role}. Pick a name and a password to claim {email}.
cms_audit_help: Every change made by an admin or editor is recorded here.
cms_published_at_help: Leave blank to publish immediately when status is set to Published. Set a future time to schedule the post.
cms_history_help: Every save creates a new snapshot per locale. Click any version to compare it with what's live.
cms_history_empty: No saved versions yet. The first save you make will appear here.
cms_history_no_diff: This version is identical to what's live.
cms_history_restore_confirm: Replace the live article with this version? Your current content will be saved as a new history entry first.
cms_settings_help: Site-wide settings. Read by both the public site and the CMS.
cms_settings_site_name_help: Shown in the navbar, page titles, and footer.
cms_settings_default_locale_help: The locale visitors land on at /. Must be one of the supported locales.
cms_settings_cdn_base_url_help: If set, media URLs are rewritten to point at this domain. Leave blank to serve from R2 directly.
cms_settings_theme_background_help: Hex only (#rrggbb). Page background of the public site via the --color-background token. Leave blank for the built-in white.
cms_settings_theme_foreground_help: Hex only (#rrggbb). Default text color of the public site via the --color-foreground token.
cms_settings_theme_accent_help: Hex only (#rrggbb). Hover and highlight surfaces via the --color-accent token.
cms_settings_theme_radius_help: A CSS length like 12px or 0.75rem (max 100px / 10rem). Rounds every corner on the public site via the --radius token; the small/medium/large scale derives from it. Try 0px for a sharp, editorial look.
cms_settings_theme_font_display_help: Font-family list for headings, no quotes — e.g. Playfair Display, serif. The font must be loaded by the deployment (app.html); this only selects it via the --font-display token. Leave blank to use the body font.
cms_no_articles: No articles yet. Create your first one!
cms_seo_title_empty: No override — search engines will use the regular title.
cms_seo_title_long: {len} chars — too long. Google truncates around 60.
cms_seo_description_empty: No override — search engines will use the excerpt.
cms_seo_description_long: {len} chars — too long. Google truncates around 160.
cms_dashboard_welcome: Quick view of what's published, what's queued, and what needs attention.
cms_dashboard_scheduled_empty: Nothing scheduled. Set a future Publish date on any article to queue it.
cms_dashboard_drafts_empty: No drafts. Start something new from the New article button.
cms_dashboard_coverage_help: Of your published articles, how many have content in each locale.
cms_dashboard_activity_empty: No activity yet — actions taken in the CMS will show up here.
cms_article_en_required_help: English content is required. The slug is derived from the English title.
cms_article_th_optional_help: Thai content is optional. Leave blank to publish English-only.
cms_slug_help: Lowercase ASCII letters, digits, hyphens. Auto-derived from the English title.
cms_delete_confirm: Delete this article? This cannot be undone.
cms_editor_preview_empty: Start typing to see a live preview.
cms_comments_help: Approve, reject, or archive visitor comments. New ones land in the pending queue.
cms_settings_comments_help: Site-wide kill switch for visitor comments. Per-article overrides on the article form still apply.
cms_settings_comments_enabled_help: When off, the comment form is hidden on every article unless overridden per-article.
cms_settings_telemetry_help: Off by default. When on, this site sends a small anonymous ping to the Khao Pad maintainers once a week so they can see how many installs are out there. It contains no site name, no domain, no visitor or user data, and no content — see docs/TELEMETRY.md for the exact fields.
cms_settings_telemetry_enabled_help: Sends the engine version, which optional plugins are on, how many locales this site serves, and rough size ranges (never exact counts). Can also be forced off with KHAOPAD_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1.
cms_settings_features_help: Optional modules installed in this build. Everything here is off until you switch it on — turning one on reveals its admin pages immediately, no deploy needed.
cms_settings_features_empty: This build ships no optional modules.
cms_settings_features_shop_help: Products, collections, orders, discounts and the finance report. Leave this off if the site does not sell online — products created here are stored separately from your regular content.
cms_article_comments_mode_help: Inherit follows the site setting. On / Off forces this article either way.
comments_empty: No comments yet — be the first.
comments_thanks: Thanks — your comment is awaiting moderation.
comments_closed: Comments are closed for this article.
cms_webhooks_help: Send platform events to external URLs. Each delivery is HMAC-SHA256 signed; receivers verify with the per-webhook secret.
cms_webhooks_secret_hint: The signing secret is shown when you click "Edit" on this webhook. Save it somewhere safe.
cms_webhooks_rotate_confirm: Rotate the signing secret? The old one will stop working immediately and you'll need to update the receiver.
cms_api_keys_help: Bearer tokens for the public read-only API. The raw key is shown once at creation; we store only a SHA-256 hash.
cms_api_keys_created_title: Key "{label}" created. Save the value below — it won't be shown again.
cms_api_keys_created_warning: After this page reloads we cannot recover the raw key. Copy it into your password manager now.
cms_api_keys_revoke_confirm: Revoke this key? It will stop working immediately.
admin_leave_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page and lose them?
admin_no_results: No matches. Try a different search or filter.
cms_subscribers_dry_run_result: Dry run: would send to {count} subscribers (article counts: {counts})
shop_payment_redirect_note: You'll be redirected to Beam to complete payment via PromptPay QR, credit card, LINE Pay, or TrueMoney.
shop_lookup_not_found: No matching order found. Check the number and email.
shop_payment_not_confirmed_yet: We haven't received payment confirmation yet. If you already paid, it can take a moment — or you can try paying again.
shop_payment_failed_try_again: The payment didn't go through. You can try again below.
shop_qr_scan_note: Scan this QR code with your banking app to pay.
shop_addr_incomplete: Please fill in name, address, city, postal code, and country.
shop_no_shipping_charge: No shipping charge for this destination.
shop_search_no_results: No results for “{query}”. Try a different keyword.
shop_search_min_length: Type at least 2 characters to search.
shop_browse_empty: No products yet — check back soon.
shop_browse_empty_collection: No products in this collection yet.
shop_admin_delete_product_help: Cascades to variants, options, and inventory. Deletion is blocked while any cart or order still references a variant; past orders keep their own title and price snapshots.
shop_admin_new_product_help: Options + variant grid can be added on the edit page after creation. Inventory stays at 0 until you set it via the inventory adjustment action.
shop_admin_title_en_help: Required — the slug is derived from this.
shop_admin_products_optional_help: Optional — products can be added now or later.
shop_admin_no_products_for_collection: No products yet — create some first to populate a collection.
shop_admin_no_collections: No collections yet. Create one to group products on the storefront.
shop_admin_analytics_note: Revenue attribution + per-line purchase events land in 4c. Until then, purchase count is 0 — purchases are only recorded at the order level, not per-product.
shop_return_requested_ok: Return request received — we'll email you once it has been reviewed.
shop_return_reason_label: Why are you returning this order? (optional)
shop_return_error: This order cannot be returned right now.
shop_return_status_approved: Approved — please send the items back
admin_bulk_delete_prompt: This permanently deletes {count} selected product(s). Type {count} to confirm.
shop_reviews_empty: No reviews yet. Be the first to review this product.
shop_reviews_form_order_help: Bought this here? Add your order number and we'll mark your review as a verified purchase.
shop_reviews_submitted: Thanks! Your review will appear after moderation.
shop_reviews_error: Could not submit your review. Please try again.
account_signin_hint: Enter your email and we'll send you a 6-digit code — no password needed.
account_code_sent: We sent a code to {email}. It expires in 5 minutes.
account_err_send_code: Could not send the code. Please try again.
account_err_verify: Invalid or expired code. Please try again.
shop_bis_success: You're on the list — we'll email you when it's back.
shop_bis_error: Could not save your email. Please try again.
shop_admin_automatic_hint: Applies automatically to every qualifying order — no code to type.
shop_report_vat_note: VAT is labeled by mode: for prices-exclusive orders it was added on top of the total; for prices-inclusive orders (the Thai default) it is broken out of the sticker price and already contained in net sales. Orders created before v3.17 in inclusive mode report ฿0 VAT.
shop_err_add_to_cart: Could not add to cart. Please try again.
shop_locale_fallback_note: This product has no Thai description yet — showing English.
careers_intro: Join {company}. Browse our open positions and apply directly.
careers_empty_body: We're not hiring for any roles at the moment. Check back soon — new openings are posted here as they become available.
shop_bundle_sold_out_note: This bundle is unavailable because one of its items is out of stock.
shop_admin_bundle_help: A bundle is sold at its own fixed price. Buying one takes the quantities below out of each item's stock. A bundle cannot contain another bundle.
shop_admin_is_bundle: Sell this product as a fixed bundle
shop_admin_bundle_none: No items yet — this bundle cannot be sold until you add at least one.
shop_admin_bundle_availability: Can make {count} bundles from current stock
shop_admin_bundle_no_candidates: No eligible items. Create a non-bundle product first.
cms_forgot_password_description: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
cms_forgot_password_sent: If that email matches an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.
cms_forgot_password_limit_note: Only one reset email can be sent per account every 24 hours.
cms_reset_password_description: Pick a new password for your account. This signs you out on every other device.
cms_reset_password_done: Password updated. You can sign in with your new password now.
cms_reset_password_invalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
cms_reset_password_missing_token: This page needs a reset link from your email to work.
cms_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
cms_dashboard_trend_label: Site views per day over the last 30 days
cms_dashboard_trend_empty_body: Views appear here once a visitor loads a page on the public site and accepts analytics cookies.
cms_dashboard_drafts_empty_body: Drafts you start will wait here until you publish them.
cms_dashboard_scheduled_empty_body: Set a publish date in the future on any article and it will queue up here.
cms_dashboard_gaps_help: Visitors searched for these and got nothing back. Each one is a brief for an article you could write.
cms_dashboard_gaps_empty_body: Every search on the site returned results.
cms_dashboard_top_articles_empty_body: Once articles are published and visited, your best performers rank here.
cms_dashboard_activity_empty_body: Edits, publishes and invites made in the CMS are logged here.
cms_dashboard_search_terms_empty_body: What visitors type into site search will appear here.
cms_dashboard_start_body: Your site has no published content yet. Once you publish, this dashboard fills with what needs your attention and how your pages are doing.
cms_dashboard_spark_label: Daily views over the last 14 days
